subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: GR10: OR condition; 'No character(s) in the sending field shall be considered a part of more than one delimiter' and 'Each delimiter is applied to the sending field in the sequence specified' (cite.py --check 14.9.48.4 -> OK 10)). Kernel: for each non-empty delimiter IndexOf(del, pos); the earliest position wins, a same-position tie keeps the first listed (strict <); the matched characters are consumed once (pointer = pos+extractLen+consumed+1), so no character belongs to two delimiters. Probe p2 over 'XABYAAAZ,,Q ': DELIMITED BY "A" OR "AB" -> A1 [X] D1 [A] C1 01, A2 [BY] D2 [A] C2 02; DELIMITED BY "AB" OR "A" -> [X][AB]01 [Y][A]01 - both the spec-derived values. Existing StringUnstringDifferentialTests.Unstring_OrDelimiters_EarliestWins_TieGoesToFirstListed is AssertSameAsLegacy (legacy differential) so it does NOT close the row; test-ref empty.
